get.description:
# Get Analytics Dashboard
---
**Everything the Dashboard shows, for one environment, in one call.** This is the endpoint the Truto Dashboard, the CLI (`truto analytics dashboard`) and the platform MCP server use. Numbers are read live from the logs and D1 and cached for 6 hours. A range that includes today runs up to now.
The response has: - **Headline numbers** (`kpis`): each figure for the range and for the span of the same length just before it (when that one is inside the 90-day window), with a daily series. Also calls by category, account events, every integration's calls and accounts, and the environment's integrated accounts as they are now. These ignore the page filters. - **`api_calls`**: API calls per day as a total, by category and by integration. - **`latency_p95`**: total and provider latency p95 per day. - **`hourly_api_calls`**: API calls per hour over the last 7 days of the range. - **`status_codes`**: API requests by HTTP status class. Background work (workflows, sync jobs, webhook deliveries) has no status and is not included. - **`errors_by_integration`**: the integrations with the most errors. - **`accounts`**: a page of the integrated accounts with the most API calls. Page it with `accounts_cursor` and search it with `accounts_search`; each page's tenant, status, label and existence are read live, and deleted accounts are left out.
Each part takes the page filters its metric accepts (`filter[category]`, `filter[integration]`): latency has no category, and the accounts table takes the integration filter only. A part that cannot be loaded right now is `null` and is named in `unavailable`; the rest of the response is still returned.
Callable with a dashboard session or an API token. An API token reaches its own environment only.
Billable API calls use the same filter as billing. Latency figures in `kpis` are the p95 over the whole range.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: The environment to report on; the caller must be able to reach it. Required with a session. With an API token it defaults to the token's environment.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: A named range ending today, inside the 90-day window. `mtd` is this month, `last_month` the whole of last month, `7d` / `30d` / `90d` the last 7, 30 or 90 days. Send this or `from` / `to`, not both. Defaults to `mtd`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: A custom range's first UTC day (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days before `to`. Clamped to the 90-day window.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A custom range's last UTC day (inclusive). Defaults to today; a range that includes today runs up to now.

parameters.name: filter

integration.description: An integration name, as the logs record it (e.g. `hubspot`).

parameters.description: Page filters, `filter[category]=<id>` and `filter[integration]=<name>`. Each part takes the ones its metric accepts; the headline numbers take none.

parameters.name: accounts_cursor
parameters.description: The `accounts.next_cursor` of the previous response, for the next page of accounts. The rest of the response is the same (served from the cache).

parameters.name: accounts_search
parameters.description: Only accounts whose id starts with this.

range.description: The named range shown, or `custom` for `from` / `to`.

window.description: The days analytics can show (the last 90 days, up to today).

cache_seconds.description: How long the parts of this response are cached.

filters.description: The page filters applied, as sent.

generated_at.description: When the numbers were read. Responses are cached for 6 hours, so a range that includes today shows today as of this time.

kpis.description: Each headline number for the range, the span of the same length before it, and a daily series. `accounts`, `active_accounts` and `active_integrations` describe the accounts as they are now, so they have no previous value or series.

inventory.description: The environment's integrations and integrated accounts as they are now (sandbox accounts excluded).

account_events.description: Integrated account lifecycle events in the range, from the logs (for example `created`, `updated`, `deleted`).

integrations.description: Every integration with API calls in the range or integrated accounts now, by API calls.

calls.description: API calls as billing counts them (the `billable_api_calls` filter).

requests.description: API requests, the denominator of the error rate.

api_calls.description: API calls per day (as billing counts them), aligned with `buckets`. `null` when it could not be loaded.

latency_p95.description: p95 latency per day in ms, total and waiting on the provider; `null` on a day without requests.

hourly_api_calls.description: API calls per hour (UTC) over the last 7 days of the range; an hour later today is `null`.

status_codes.description: API requests by HTTP status class (`2`, `4`, `5`, ...), largest first.

errors_by_integration.description: The integrations with the most requests that returned HTTP 400 or above. An empty `key` is calls with no integration (Admin API calls, and requests that failed before an integration was known).

accounts.description: One page of the integrated accounts with the most API calls in the range. Only accounts that still exist are listed.

label.description: The account's `context.label`, when it is text.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `accounts_cursor` for the next page.

unavailable.description: Parts that could not be loaded right now and are `null` (`api_calls`, `latency`, `hourly_api_calls`, `status_codes`, `errors_by_integration`, `accounts`).

400.description: Missing `environment_id`; a malformed date, an unknown `range`, `range` sent with `from`/`to`, or a range outside the window; a filter other than `category` / `integration`; an invalid `accounts_cursor` or `accounts_search`; or a query parameter the route does not take

403.description: Forbidden if the caller cannot reach the environment (an API token reaches its own environment only), or uses an integrated-account or tenant token

429.description: More uncached analytics reads for this environment than the per-minute limit allows. Retry after the `Retry-After` header (60 seconds). Cached responses are not limited.

502.description: The logs could not be read. The response carries a generic message; retry in a minute.

# Get Analytics Time Series
---
**One metric per day (or per hour for up to 7 days)**, read live from the logs and cached for 6 hours. Optionally grouped by a dimension (top 10 groups, the rest summed as `__other__` for additive metrics) and filtered with `filter[<dimension>]=<value>`. The range is clamped to the 90-day window ending today; an hour later today is `null`, not `0`.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: The environment to report on. The caller must belong to it.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Defaults to 30 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Defaults to today.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: `hour` covers at most 7 days, for a metric with hourly data (see `GET /analytics/metrics`).

400.description: Unknown metric, dimension, filter or query parameter; a dimension or filter the metric does not support; a value with control characters; a malformed date; or a range outside the window

403.description: Forbidden if the caller cannot reach the environment (an API token reaches its own environment only), or uses an integrated-account or tenant token

429.description: More uncached analytics reads for this environment than the per-minute limit allows. Retry after the `Retry-After` header (60 seconds). Cached responses are not limited.

502.description: The logs could not be read. The response carries a generic message; retry in a minute.

get.description:
# Get Analytics Breakdown
---
**One metric over a date range, ranked by a dimension**, highest first, with cursor pagination (`next_cursor`). Read live from the logs; a ranking is cached for 6 hours and its pages are served from it (the tenant, status, label and whether the account still exists are read live for each page). With `dimension=integrated_account` (metrics `api_calls`, `billable_api_calls` and `errors`), rows also carry the account's integration, calls (billable calls when ranking by them), errors, when it was last active, tenant id, current status and label, and `search` (a prefix of the account id) and `tenant_id` narrow the list. Only accounts that still exist in the environment are listed: one deleted since (on its own, or with its integration's uninstall) is left out, though its traffic still counts in the other breakdowns. A `tenant_id` with more than 1,000 accounts in the environment is refused.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: The environment to report on. The caller must belong to it.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC day (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days before `to`. Clamped to the 90-day window.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC day (inclusive). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The start of an integrated account id (`dimension=integrated_account` only).

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Only that tenant's accounts in this environment (`dimension=integrated_account` only). Refused when the tenant has more than 1,000 accounts here.

last_active_at.description: When the account was last seen in the range (UTC), for `dimension=integrated_account`.

status.description: The account's current status (not its status during the range).

label.description: The account's `context.label` (who or what it belongs to), for `dimension=integrated_account`. `null` when the account has no text label.

400.description: Unknown metric, dimension or query parameter; a dimension the metric cannot be broken down by; an invalid `limit` or `cursor`; a value with control characters; `search`/`tenant_id` with a dimension other than `integrated_account`; or a `tenant_id` with more than 1,000 accounts in the environment

403.description: Forbidden if the caller cannot reach the environment (an API token reaches its own environment only), or uses an integrated-account or tenant token

429.description: More uncached analytics reads for this environment than the per-minute limit allows. Retry after the `Retry-After` header (60 seconds). Cached responses are not limited.

502.description: The logs could not be read. The response carries a generic message; retry in a minute.
